thread:
emma: noticed a brief spike where the console showed duplicate streams for one client_id on eu-central. logs show resume token present but runtime allocated a new session: ```INFO sse: resume_token=true prev_shard=sh-5 new_shard=sh-12 new_sid=s-42 reason=lease_miss```
rick: billing ok?
emma: billing pipeline fine. only per-route active_sessions jumped and alert fired.
sanjay: this is the resume vs fallback ambiguity. when resume lands on a different shard we create a fresh session but we currently don't emit an outcome flag. console treats new_sid as separate connection.
rick: quick mitigation: emit a low-cardinality counter sse.session_start with tag outcome in {accepted, fallback, fresh} and region. keep tenant out of the tagset.
emma: also add a sampled tiny diag when token present but new session created (prev_shard, new_shard, client_ip_hash, reason). sample 0.5% to avoid hot-path cost.
sanjay: UI change: show a subtle "resumed" pill if resume_token present AND previous session last_seen < 15s. tooltip: "Client reattached using resume token; routing fallback created a new backend session. This does not indicate double billing." put behind a feature flag to reduce NAT mislabels.
ops-bot: alert suppressed: sse.duplicate_streams triggered 2026-04-10T08:14:02Z (auto-resolved)
rick: rollout plan: telemetry-only canary 5% tenants -> alert tweak to ignore dup spikes when resume_ratio>0.4 -> UI FF internal -> expand. monitor false_positive_rate by comparing pill hits vs distinct client_ip_hash.
emma: created PLAT-10123 and will link telem + console + alert PRs. thanks.
